description: Search Tribute Paper's designs for funeral programs, order of service booklets, memorial and celebration of life cards, homegoing programs, Catholic funeral Mass booklets, anniversaries, headstone unveilings, death announcements, thank-you cards and pet memorials. Understands everyday words from the US, UK, Canada and Australia ("order of service", "homegoing", "year's mind") and small typos. Filter by kind of service, faith or tradition, style, color, or designs with a photo. Returns each design's name, kind, a short description and its page link. Every design comes in every size, including a folded program booklet. get_design gives one design's full details.

category.description: Only designs of this kind: funeral-service (Funeral Service), memorial-service (Memorial Service), celebration-of-life (Celebration of Life), homegoing-service (Homegoing Service), funeral-mass (Catholic Funeral Mass), graveside-service (Graveside Service), military-funeral (Military Funeral), first-anniversary (First Anniversary), memorial-mass (Anniversary Mass), headstone-unveiling (Headstone Unveiling), heavenly-birthday (Birthday in Heaven), ashes-scattering (Scattering of Ashes), forty-day-memorial (Forty-Day Memorial), death-announcement (Death Announcement), funeral-thank-you (Funeral Thank-You), pet-memorial (Pet Memorial).

faith.description: Only designs made for this faith or tradition: any (Non-religious / any), christian (Christian), jewish (Jewish), muslim (Muslim), hindu (Hindu), sikh (Sikh), buddhist (Buddhist), chinese (Chinese).

has_photo.description: true: only designs with a place for a photo of the person.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 20, default 8).

query.description: What the family is looking for, in their words, e.g. "catholic funeral mass booklet", "celebration of life with photo", "order of service blue". Leave out to list popular designs.
